method: Two passes on the same floorplan (die_floorplan_ch8.64, W10 p5 pair), k=32 bundling. Pass 1: x-broadcast (xb), result (rs) trunks and their 1-bundle path probes (px, pr) routed ALONE with set_routing_layers -signal M8-M9 at full M8/M9 capacity. Pass 2: every other net on M2-M9 (M2-M7 adjustment 0.25 as before), with the M8/M9 capacity each 4x4-GCell block lost to pass 1 charged as a region adjustment (tools/w18/route_combine.py --emit-regions, used fraction rounded UP to 0.05, every block with any trunk use; 29,050 regions). Pass 2 closing with 0 overflow against that charged capacity means trunk + other demand fits every block's raw capacity. OpenROAD GRT has no per-net layer range for signal nets (a CLOCK sig type or an STA clock on the trunk drivers is not picked up: 'Found 0 clock nets'), hence the split.
trunk_layer_note: the M4-M7 share (<=2.2%) is pin access: the cluster pins are on M5, so each trunk leaves the pin by a via stack
